parsed.rationale: Both participating records live in test files: `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package `Metadata`) and `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package `app:iOS`). Although the context flags do not set `is_test: true`, the file paths unambiguously place both declarations inside `Tests/` directories, making them test fixtures. Lifting a shared `MockDiscogsEntityResolver` into production or shared code would couple test-only mock semantics into a non-test target, which is the canonical restraint pattern. The duplication is intentional: each test module independently defines the minimal mock it needs.
